$description: The inputs of this kit's tokens.css. scripts/tokens.mjs reads them and the three sibling skills.

flatRings.$description: ui-materials, fills.md: an unlit material gives an operable boundary an even ring where its fill alone does not separate it from its ground. With one neutral, a raised face has the ground's own colour, so the kit sets both rings. Since D117 the neutral is split, a raised face is lighter than its ground, and its ring is the quiet line; a field keeps the strong one. The last entry is not a ring: the recipes use the faint ink only for a disabled mark, and ui-materials gives it ui-colors' subtle text, which reads as text; the kit gives it the disabled role (D121). In the dark scheme a recess that sits on the base ground has the ground's own fill as well, so a tray takes a quieter ring.

icons.$description: The kit's icons. scripts/icons.mjs writes kit/styles/icons.css from them. `source` is a folder of SVG files, one per icon; `names` maps each name the kit uses to a file in it, without the extension. To use another library, point `source` at its folder and change the file names on the right.
